scope: All full combination definitions containing chosen existing BTCs; metadata lookup, no new strategy evaluation.

logic.allocation: Raw1/1=one whole10000BTC book+one whole10000ETH book,total20000. EntryN BTC/ETH presets1000/3000,2000/2000,3000/1000 total4000 (20percent initialparent capital);not normalizedweights,rebalancing,transfer or compoundresizing. Actual quantity/gap may alter livegross.
logic.exposure: Use exact native sourceorderquantity,cost,funding,margin/state paths for each N. No linear rescaling or cross-sleeve collateral bailout.
logic.reuse: Recover source fullNAV from savedimmutable signedcash/quantity/entry state segments and actual axis prices,verify every originalNAVSHA. Never call source simulate,trade,funding or signal functions;no old result/status rewriting.
logic.alignment: Unionof source (actualns,eventtype) keys;preserveeventorder atsametime. Atmissingotherassetkey carry its last completed sourceNAVobservation,never interpolate or lookahead. Relativekey=(ts-commonstart)*16+eventcode avoids epochint64overflow.
logic.costs: Source1/2/3xexecutionandnegativefundingoutflowstress inherited in actualmatchedcostpaths;positivefundingincomeunscaled. Sum actual fees/funding once,no portfolio turnover fees since no new trade.
logic.risk: Recompute return/Sharpe/Calmar/wholeOOSDDfrom combinedfullcurve,not average components. Check both originalindependentmarginproxies separately;never offset a failed sleeve with othercash. MixedsampledNAV nottruetickmarkrisk.
logic.state: One continuous370day component path across12complete30dayfolds+10daytail. Parent initial20000=two10000 banks. No source simulation or Sep14 state reset. Recent40 is inherited segment,not a fresh allocation.

logic.allocation: Two separate10000USDT banks,total20000,parentraw multipliers1/1 unchanged. CoupledBTC/ETHfixedentrybudget presets1000/3000,3000/1000;old2000/2000 readonly midpoint. Total4000=20%initialparentcapital. These are entryamounts,NOTcapitalweights25/75;each bank remains10000. Size floor(N/priorcompletedclose/lot)*lot;retainactualq,never resizeoldNAV. No normalization,compoundsize,transfers,cashyield,crossmargin orparentrebalance;mark/gapsmaymoveactualgrossnotional awayfromentrybudget.
logic.composition: BTCtrend fixedL31H4percent,E.5/1/2percent;ETHreversalL1/2/3,H2/4/6percent,ROCzeroexit.18newnativeETHamountvariants,54newparentpairs.6BTCcomponents reconstructedfromoriginalledgers,no simulation;9nativeETHmidpoints and27parentmidpoints readoriginalreports only.

trend_rule.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Inside or on entrybands,existinglong persists strictly while ROC>-E;existingshort persists strictly while ROC<E. Long exits at ROC<=-E;short exits at ROC>=E. Crossing opposite strict fullentryband closesold then opensopposite at00:01. E<=H,at exact +/-H no newentry. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
trend_rule.execution: NextUTC00:01 nativeOPEN;closeopposite first then enter. Quantity=floor(spec.fixed_entry_notional_usdt/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction;fixed raw N,no future OPEN/NAV/unpublishedfunding sizing;retain actualsame-directionquantity.
trend_rule.allocation: Independent10000USDT collateral;raw N1000/2000/3000 means10/20/30percent fixed initialcollateral per newentry,not targetweight rebalancing or NAV-scaled compound size. No borrowing/transfer/cashyield. Existing1x fullycollateralized postfee entrycap unchanged.
trend_rule.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
trend_rule.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
trend_rule.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.
trend_rule.state: One cold10000collateral start2025-10-19 across12complete30dayfolds +10daytail. Cash,signedq,entryprice/reference,funding/costs carry continuously through formerSep14terminal;onlynewOct24terminal is costedclosed. Original330dayreports andSMA/paper10accounts unchanged.

reversal_rule.signal: At dailyi00:01,use only precedingcompleteclose ROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. L1/2/3days,H2/4/6percent. StrictROC>H targets short;ROC<-H targets long. Insideentrybands retain actualexistinglong onlywhileROC<0 oractualexistingshort onlywhileROC>0;otherwiseflat. EqualityROC=0 exits;flat atentrythreshold equality doesnotenter. Oppositeextremehaspriority:close thenopenopposite,withbothcosts. ROCzeroexit is a signalrule,not a promise of entryprice recovery orprofit.
reversal_rule.execution: PriorcompleteROCdecision,execute next00:01 OPEN;closebeforeopen;nativeN1000/3000 differsbyfrozenparameter. Exact priorclose floor sizing,retainactualq. No futureOPEN/funding/partialclose in signal orsize.

Source entryN1000/3000/3000,owned effective entrybudget1000+3000*a+3000*(1-a)=4000=20percentinitialparent. Static ownership,no source order resizing,fund-unit trades,transfers,rebalance,cash yield or crossmargin.

native_ETH_rule.signal: AtUTC00:01 usepriorcompleteclose ROC L3/4,H2/2.5/3percentasexactspecparameter. Strict ROC>H short/<-H long;insidebandretainactual longonlyROC<0,shortonlyROC>0;zeroexit. Compute three exact slowROCs at S-1/S/S+1,S27/28/29. Atleasttwo strictlypositive permitslong,atleasttwo strictlynegative permitsshort,otherwiseflat. Desiredfastdirectionmustmatchallowedslowmajority;fromcashnewentryrequiresnewstrictextreme,nohiddenstate. Notmedianofrecentpricebars,notthree parallel orders.
native_ETH_rule.allocation: Single10000USDTbank,actualnewentryN3000 usingpriorcompleteclose and native lotfloor;noNAVresizing,transfer orcrossmargin.
native_ETH_rule.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
native_ETH_rule.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
native_ETH_rule.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior complete close fast ROC L3/4, H2/2.5/3percent. Strict ROC>H proposes short; ROC<-H proposes long; otherwise retain actual long only while ROC<0, actual short only while ROC>0, else flat. If actual current_direction is nonzero and fast proposed direction equals it, retain actual quantity regardless of the slow gate. For cash or opposite proposed direction, allow new entry only if at least two exact slow ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match the proposed direction, S27/28/29; other cases flat. Zero slow magnitude hurdle, strict signs, ties neutral. No hidden desired state: cash reentry requires a fresh strict fast extreme. Opposite proposal closes first; reopen only if slow gate allows it. Slow gate applies to entries only, not retention; fast zero/opposite still exits.
native_ETH_rule.execution: Next UTC00:01 actual OPEN, close before opening; one10000bank fixed entry N3000, quantity=floor(N/priorcompleteclose/lot)*lot. Retain actual same-direction quantity; no future OPEN, funding or partial close in signals or sizing.
native_ETH_rule.allocation: Single10000USDTbank,actualnewentryN3000 usingpriorcompleteclose and native lotfloor;noNAVresizing,transfer orcrossmargin.
native_ETH_rule.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
native_ETH_rule.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.

No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.

logic.composition: One fixed BTC ROC31/H4percent/E1percent N1000 bank plus ETH_A original entries-and-retention slow-majority bank and ETH_B entry-only slow-majority bank. Both ETH banks have identical exact H2/2.5/3percent, slowcenterS27/28/29,fastL3/4,N3000,zero fast exit. Three full original parameter dictionaries and component fingerprints bind every spec. logic.allocation: Raw[1,a,1-a],a.25/.5/.75,not normalized. Owned initialcapital[10000,10000*a,10000*(1-a)]sum20000. native_BTC_rule.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Inside or on entrybands,existinglong persists strictly while ROC>-E;existingshort persists strictly while ROC<E. Long exits at ROC<=-E;short exits at ROC>=E. Crossing opposite strict fullentryband closesold then opensopposite at00:01. E<=H,at exact +/-H no newentry. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
native_BTC_rule.execution: NextUTC00:01 nativeOPEN;closeopposite first then enter. Quantity=floor(spec.fixed_entry_notional_usdt/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction;fixed raw N,no future OPEN/NAV/unpublishedfunding sizing;retain actualsame-directionquantity.
native_BTC_rule.allocation: Independent10000USDT collateral;raw N1000/2000/3000 means10/20/30percent fixed initialcollateral per newentry,not targetweight rebalancing or NAV-scaled compound size. No borrowing/transfer/cashyield. Existing1x fullycollateralized postfee entrycap unchanged.
native_BTC_rule.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
native_BTC_rule.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.

For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S27/28/29,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3/4 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.015/-0.01/-0.005 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S27/28/29,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.
native_ETH_rule.execution: Next UTC00:01 actual OPEN;close before open;fixed N3000/10000bank,quantity=floor(N/prior completed close/lot)*lot. No future OPEN,funding,partial close,NAV sizing or same-direction resizing.
native_ETH_rule.allocation: Single10000USDTbank,actualnewentryN3000 usingpriorcompleteclose and native lotfloor;noNAVresizing,transfer orcrossmargin.
native_ETH_rule.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
native_ETH_rule.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
native_ETH_rule.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.

logic.interpretation: Positive exit buffers improved some fullperiod returns but all36failedrecent6of8. Test the opposite native persistence hypothesis:exit actual contrarian positions before fast ROC reaches zero,Enegative but abs(E)<Hentry. Shorter holds may redistribute PnL across chronological folds and reduce exposure/funding;more churn or premature exits may erase profits after costs. Freeze negativeE/S/L batch before new PnL;qualification unchanged. Reuse old zero/positiveE results as genuine numeric neighbors and matched equal-magnitude delayed-exit controls,no old model rerun or requalification.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3/4 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.015/-0.01/-0.005 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S27/28/29,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.
native_ETH_rule.execution: Next UTC00:01 actual OPEN;close before open;fixed N3000/10000bank,quantity=floor(N/prior completed close/lot)*lot. No future OPEN,funding,partial close,NAV sizing or same-direction resizing.
native_ETH_rule.allocation: Single10000USDTbank,actualnewentryN3000 usingpriorcompleteclose and native lotfloor;noNAVresizing,transfer orcrossmargin.
native_ETH_rule.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
native_ETH_rule.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
native_ETH_rule.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.

logic.interpretation: Positive exit buffers improved some fullperiod returns but all36failedrecent6of8. Test the opposite native persistence hypothesis:exit actual contrarian positions before fast ROC reaches zero,Enegative but abs(E)<Hentry. Shorter holds may redistribute PnL across chronological folds and reduce exposure/funding;more churn or premature exits may erase profits after costs. Freeze negativeE/S/L batch before new PnL;qualification unchanged. Reuse old zero/positiveE results as genuine numeric neighbors and matched equal-magnitude delayed-exit controls,no old model rerun or requalification.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3/4 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.015/-0.01/-0.005 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S27/28/29,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3/4 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.015/-0.01/-0.005 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S27/28/29,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.
native_ETH_rule.execution: Next UTC00:01 actual OPEN;close before open;fixed N3000/10000bank,quantity=floor(N/prior completed close/lot)*lot. No future OPEN,funding,partial close,NAV sizing or same-direction resizing.
native_ETH_rule.allocation: Single10000USDTbank,actualnewentryN3000 usingpriorcompleteclose and native lotfloor;noNAVresizing,transfer orcrossmargin.
native_ETH_rule.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
native_ETH_rule.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
native_ETH_rule.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3/4 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.015/-0.01/-0.005 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S27/28/29,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.
native_ETH_rule.execution: Next UTC00:01 actual OPEN;close before open;fixed N3000/10000bank,quantity=floor(N/prior completed close/lot)*lot. No future OPEN,funding,partial close,NAV sizing or same-direction resizing.

Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3/4 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S27/28/29,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.015/-0.01/-0.005 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S30/31,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.

native_ETH_rule.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.01 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S28,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.
